clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau reads the story of a man named Graves, who wanted to open his own fast food restaurant.

To raise the money for the first location, he worked 90-hour weeks in an oil refinery, then went to Alaska and fished for salmon on boats - sleeping on the floor and saving every dollar along the way.

Kevin Trudeau's point: successful people are willing to do what everyone else refuses to do. It is not luck. It is putting in the time nobody else wants to put in.

What is the one hard thing you have been avoiding on the way to your goal?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #entrepreneur #hardwork #wealthhabits #businesslessons
clips.send: A broke college grad sends it to a friend afraid to start: awe - he fished for salmon on boats just to fund his first store.
